annotations.title: Get an itemized tax return quote

description: Use this when a user wants to know what Arc & Ledger would charge to prepare their tax return and can describe their situation: the type of return, number of states, foreign accounts, K-1s, rental properties, crypto activity, and whether prior years are unfiled. Returns the exact published line items and a total, computed by the same engine as the firm's quote page. For a broad price range by service category without these details, use get_fee_quote instead.

behind_years.description: True if one or more prior-year returns are unfiled.

clean_books.description: Business filers only: true if the books are reconciled and current, false if they need cleanup first.

crypto.description: Crypto activity in the year: none, some (up to 50 transactions), or heavy (50 to 500 transactions).

filing.description: The main return: w2 (individual, wage income), self_employed (Schedule C or single-member LLC), scorp_partnership (Form 1120-S or 1065), ccorp (Form 1120), or foreign_llc (foreign-owned LLC, Form 5472 with pro-forma 1120).

foreign_accounts.description: True if the taxpayer has foreign bank or brokerage accounts over the FBAR reporting threshold.

k1_count.description: Number of Schedule K-1s the taxpayer receives.

multi_entity.description: True if more than one entity, or a cross-border group, is involved.

rental_count.description: Number of rental properties reported on Schedule E.

states.description: Number of states with a filing requirement. One state is included in the base return.

name: get_itemized_quote

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: The arcandledger.com page that backs this answer.
